checks.proves: Maps every current Captain tracking/proof writer, identity field and readback for adversarial review.
checks.doesNotProve: Search does not prove native permissions, database isolation or weak-network runtime.
checks.passCriteria: Every live write is actor/assignment scoped and no local fabricated-success or unnecessary location truth remains.
checks.failCriteria: An unscoped writer, stale local completion path or privacy leak is found.

checks.command: pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime lint && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime test && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime build
checks.proves: Captain source, types, tests/runtime contract and export build pass after tracking/support changes.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not replace physical-device camera/location/weak-network evidence.
checks.passCriteria: All four commands exit zero without suppressed material failures.

checks.proves: Support/incident/rescue and related route tests pass on the candidate.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not by itself prove app navigation or visual/device behavior.
checks.passCriteria: All targeted tests exit zero and touched authorization/state branches have negative coverage.
checks.failCriteria: Any target test fails or changed ownership/conflict branch lacks coverage.

checks.proves: Enumerates all current Captain support route identifiers/callers and the canonical conversation implementation after cleanup.
checks.doesNotProve: Search alone cannot prove runtime reachability/authorization.
checks.passCriteria: Every live entry is one canonical model or a deliberate alias to it; no live disabled-vs-active contradiction, dead route/type/copy or parallel behavior remains.
checks.failCriteria: Divergent live routes or unexplained obsolete support artifacts remain.

checks.proves: Makes ownership, internal-note, expected-state, idempotency, audit and rescue boundaries explicit for final review.
checks.doesNotProve: Static review is not runtime actor isolation.
checks.passCriteria: No unassigned/cross-actor support, internal-note leak, stale overwrite, local rescue truth or DSH finance mutation remains.
checks.failCriteria: Any such boundary defect is found.

checks.command: pnpm openapi:compose:dsh && pnpm guard:api-binding && pnpm guard:no-broken-imports && pnpm guard:cleanup-policy
checks.proves: DSH contracts/bindings and repository cleanup/import guards remain coherent after route/proof/support removals or refactors.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not replace runtime/device/actor evidence.
checks.passCriteria: All commands exit zero on the final U005 candidate.
checks.failCriteria: Contract drift, broken import or cleanup-policy violation is reported.
